definitions.gloss: official seal; public seal; institutional seal
definitions.explanation: A seal used by a government office, public organization, or company to authenticate official documents. Distinct from personal seals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{公印|こういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: To stamp an official seal on a document.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公印|こういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: An official seal is required on this certificate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公印|こういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無効|むこう}→無効：13385_mukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Documents without the city office's official seal are invalid.

notes:
Composed of {公|こう} (public, official) and {印|いん} (seal, stamp). In Japan, seals (⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧) play an important role in authenticating documents. A {公印|こういん} is the institutional equivalent, used by government offices, schools, and organizations to certify official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公印|こういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to stamp with an official seal
- {公印|こういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: an official seal is required
- {公印|こういん}⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧: omission of the official seal (common on digitized documents)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧: personal seal — a registered seal used by individuals
- {社印|しゃいん}: company seal — the official seal of a corporation
- ⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧: registered seal — a personal seal officially registered with the local government
- ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧: informal seal — used for everyday acknowledgments
